name: CyberSolve-LinAlg-1.2-correctness-benchmark
description: A correctness benchmark of linear algebra problems intended to evaluate models' ability to produce mathematically correct solutions (proofs, derivations, and numeric results) for linear algebra tasks. Problems cover standard topics in linear algebra and focus on verifying whether model outputs match expected correct results. The benchmark emphasizes solution correctness rather than code execution.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented benchmark used by a small community studying mathematical reasoning in LLMs; not widely adopted as a mainstream benchmark.
